host: Dr. Ben Winters ("The Bentist"), orthodontist in Plano, Texas

youtube.note: Recent long-form videos land 6K-75K views with rare 300K+ outliers; vague-consequence titles ('This isn't normal..') underperform, specific/superlative titles ('57 Most SATISFYING Dental TikToks', 'I've only seen this once in my career') outperform.

audience: Teens, young adults, and parents. Braces wearers, people anxious about the dentist, people who love watching a real doctor react to wild dental content.
voice: Warm, funny, fast, genuinely kind. Never mocks the person in the clip, only the idea. Educates in the middle of a laugh. Uses 'you' constantly. Plain English, no jargon without an instant translation.
formats: Orthodontist Reacts (commentary on viral dental / braces / DIY clips)
Ranked lists (worst dental hacks, best braces colors, etc.)
Story-driven explainers (why a trend went viral and what actually happens in the mouth)
never: Shame a viewer for their teeth
Repeat a claim without a mechanism ('here is what is actually happening in your mouth')
cta: Comment your braces color, subscribe for more reacts, and ask your orthodontist before trying anything you see online.
